set.scene.dropFloaters: Drop floating pieces under N blocks
set.scene.dropFloaters.help: Noisy scans have floating specks that become invisible walls the drone crashes into. Every piece of the walls smaller than this many blocks (a block is 4×4×4 voxels) is removed, for this scan only. 0 keeps everything; the voxel grid shows what is left.
voxels.dropFloaters.off: Floating pieces kept: every piece counts as a wall again
voxels.dropped: {pieces} floating pieces under {n} blocks dropped from the walls
voxels.dropHint: Settings → Walls and voxel grid can drop the small ones from the walls
